title: SIERRA AGI DEMOS
subtitle: Sierra On-Line · demo pack 1, on ScummVM 0.10.0 (2007): its AGI engine
argsHint: --render-mode=ega|cga|amiga: the AGI engine leaves its colours unset without it. Then -p<dir> where the game is, and its id. Other switches: -g<scaler>, -f full screen, -m<volume> music, -s<volume> effects.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: agi-dos-pack1-demo-en/files/ from agi-dos-pack1-demo-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes

_why: Held to a native g++ build of 0.10.0 frame by frame (gate-scummvm010, 3,000 frames), both with --render-mode=ega: without it the render mode is an uninitialised member, which the native build read as CGA.
